title: 第5章  将军之女，三皇子崩溃了！
slug: 开局自曝系统父皇举国助我娶妻
content_zh:
圣旨的内容，如同一道九天惊雷，在赵辰安、赵辰宇和乌兰雪三人的脑海中同时炸响！
三皇子赵辰宇猛地抬头，整个人都傻了。
赵辰安则是在最初的震惊之后，心中瞬间掀起了滔天巨浪！
父皇，您这执行力，不去当996卷王真是可惜了！
我前脚刚告诉你“娶妻资质越高，奖励越丰厚”，你后脚就把大将军的女儿给我送过来了？
这一刻，赵辰安彻底明白了。
这不是惩罚，也不是什么随机的恩赐。
这是试探！
是父皇赵道霆，对他那个“上古传承”的第一次，也是最直接的一次投资和测试！
魏公公合上圣旨，居高临下地看着跪在最前方的赵辰安，面无表情。
“十六皇子，接旨吧。”
赵辰安缓缓抬起双手，动作沉稳而标准，没有一丝一毫的颤抖。
“儿臣，谢父皇隆恩。”
他恭敬地从魏公公手中接过了那卷足以改变无数人命运的明黄色卷轴。
入手，微沉。
魏公公那张布满褶子的老脸，看不出任何情绪。
他只是意味深长地瞥了一眼旁边已经彻底石化的三皇子赵辰宇。
那浑浊的眸子里，像是有几分怜悯，又像是有几分嘲弄。
随即，他一甩拂尘，转身便走，没有多说一个字。
一队禁军甲胄铿锵，紧随其后，很快便消失在了府门之外。

人走了，但那道圣旨带来的恐怖压力，却依然笼罩着整个前厅。
“不……不可能……”
死寂之中，一个破碎的、充满着荒谬与不解的喃喃自语响起。
赵辰宇还跪在地上，整个人像是被抽走了骨头，瘫软在那里。
他缓缓抬起头，布满血丝的双目死死盯着赵辰安手中的圣旨，仿佛要将它看穿。
李青鸾……
赐给老十六当侧妃？
七日后完婚？
每一个字，都像是一柄烧红的铁锤，狠狠砸在他的心上。
他猛地从地上爬起来，因为动作太急，一个踉跄差点摔倒。
“十六弟……”
赵辰宇冲到赵辰安面前，一把揪住他的衣领，嘶哑地质问：
“是你！是不是你跟父皇说了什么？！”
赵辰安任由他抓着，脸上挂着符合人设的茫然与无辜。
“三哥，我……我也不知道啊，我刚从宫里回来，父皇什么都没说……”
这副样子，落在癫狂的赵辰宇眼中，更是火上浇油。
一个连苦海都无法开辟的废物！
一个他随手就能捏死的蝼蚁！
凭什么？！
他心心念念，不惜顶撞父皇，不惜拒绝天狼圣女也要得到的女人。

凭什么就这么轻飘飘地被赐给了这个废物！
“我不信！我不信！”
赵辰宇猛地松开手，像是被烫到了一样连连后退。
他失魂落魄地摇着头，嘴里不停地念叨着。
“我要去见父皇，我一定要亲自问个清楚！”
他看也不看赵辰安，更没有理会一旁同样面无血色的乌兰雪，就那么状若疯魔地冲出了十六皇子府。
看着三哥那几乎要崩溃的背影，赵辰安在心中啧啧感叹。
可怜的三哥啊。
为了李青鸾，拒绝为大周联姻，把这口黑锅甩给了自己这个“废柴弟弟”。
他大概以为，自己只要熬到李大将军凯旋，再上门提亲。
凭借自己母妃的势力和自己的“天赋”，这门亲事十拿九稳。
他怎么也想不到，父皇转手就是一个回旋镖。
把他心心念念的女神，打包送到了他最看不起的弟弟床上。
这下场，真是闻者伤心，见者落泪。
当然，自己除外。
赵辰安甚至有点想笑。
就在这时，他感觉自己的衣袖被轻轻地拽了一下。
他回过头，看到了乌兰雪那张苍白如纸的小脸。
她站在那里，娇小的身躯微微发抖。
刚刚因为赵辰安那句“喜欢得很”而升起的满心甜蜜，此刻已经被一片冰寒所取代。

侧妃……
夫君又要娶别人了。
还是车骑大将军的女儿。
是那个带兵击败了天狼部落，让她从高高在上的圣女，沦为和亲牺牲品的李擎苍的女儿！
一股难以言喻的屈辱和冰冷，瞬间攥紧了她的心脏。
这算什么？
是大周王朝对战败者的又一次宣告吗？
让胜利者的女儿，和战败者的公主，共侍一夫。
重点是这个所谓的胜利者，还要成为妾室。
被自己在身份和地位上碾压一头！
她实在搞不清楚，大周皇帝到底在想什么！
赵辰安看着她黯淡下去的清澈眸子，瞬间就洞悉了她心中所有的不安与委屈。
他心中一软，上前一步，将她揽入怀中。
怀中的娇躯明显一僵。
“担心了？”
他低沉的嗓音在她耳边响起。
乌兰雪咬着下唇，没有说话。
但那越发用力的、抓着他衣袖的小手，已经暴露了她所有的情绪。
赵辰安轻叹一声，捧起她的小脸，让她正视自己。
“听着。”

他的神态前所未有的认真。
“你是十六皇子妃，是父皇下旨，明媒正娶抬进我赵辰安府里的正妻。”
“这个身份，永远不会变。”
“至于其他人……”
赵辰安顿了顿，一字一句地说道：
“无论她是谁的女儿，进了这个门，就只是侧室，是妾。”
“正妻，与妾，之间的差别。”
“你，明白吗？”
他的话，像是带着一股安抚人心的力量。
乌兰雪怔怔地看着他，看着他认真的神态，听着他郑重的承诺。
正妻……侧室……
是啊，她是正妃。
那个李青鸾，哪怕家世再显赫，也只是个侧妃。
在等级森严的皇家，这道鸿沟，不可逾越。
夫君他……是在安抚自己，也是在给自己撑腰。
那颗沉入冰窖的心，仿佛被一束温暖的阳光照到，缓缓回暖。
她鼻尖一酸，再也忍不住，把脸埋进赵辰安的胸膛，轻轻地“嗯”了一声。
赵辰安搂着怀中温软的娇躯，心中却掀起了另一层波澜。
“所以，本殿下的正妻，你愿不愿意为我生一个小皇子呢？”
听到高赵辰安的话，乌兰雪一愣，随后立刻用行动表明了自己的心意！

一个热烈的激吻！
content_en:
The content of the imperial edict was like a thunder from the sky, exploding in the minds of Zhao Chenan, Zhao Chenyu and Wu Lanxue at the same time!
The third prince, Zhao Chenyu, suddenly raised his head and was stunned.
Zhao Chenan, after the initial shock, instantly felt a huge wave in his heart!
Father, with your execution ability, it would be a pity not to be the King of Volume 996!
I just told you, "The higher the qualifications for marrying a wife, the richer the reward." Then you sent me the general's daughter?
At this moment, Zhao Chenan completely understood.
This is not a punishment, nor is it some random gift.
This is a temptation!
It was his father, Zhao Daoting, who made the first and most direct investment and test of his "ancient inheritance"!
Eunuch Wei closed the imperial edict and looked down at Zhao Chenan who was kneeling at the front with an expressionless face.
"Sixteenth Prince, accept the order."
Zhao Chenan slowly raised his hands, his movements steady and standard, without any trembling.
"My son, thank you father for your kindness."
He respectfully took the bright yellow scroll from Eunuch Wei's hand, which could change the fate of countless people.
Started, slightly sinking.
Eunuch Wei's old wrinkled face showed no emotion.
He just glanced meaningfully at the third prince Zhao Chenyu who was completely petrified next to him.
There seemed to be a bit of pity and a bit of ridicule in those cloudy eyes.
Immediately, he flicked the fly whisk, turned around and left without saying a word.
A group of Forbidden Army soldiers with clanging armor followed closely behind and soon disappeared outside the gate of the mansion.
The person left, but the terrifying pressure brought by the imperial edict still enveloped the entire front hall.
"No...impossible..."
In the dead silence, a broken murmur filled with absurdity and incomprehension sounded.
Zhao Chenyu was still kneeling on the ground, his whole body seemed to have had his bones taken away, and he was paralyzed there.
He slowly raised his head, his bloodshot eyes staring intently at the imperial edict in Zhao Chenan's hand, as if he wanted to see through it.
Li Qingluan...
Giving Lao Shiliu the title of concubine?
Getting married in seven days?
Every word was like a red-hot hammer hitting his heart.
He suddenly got up from the ground, staggering and almost falling because he moved too quickly.
"Sixteenth brother..."
Zhao Chenyu rushed to Zhao Chenan, grabbed him by the collar, and asked hoarsely:
"It's you! Did you say something to my father?!"
Zhao Chenan let him hold him, with a look of confusion and innocence that fit his character.
"Third brother, I...I don't know. I just came back from the palace, and my father didn't say anything..."
This look, in the eyes of the crazy Zhao Chenyu, only added fuel to the fire.
A waste that can't even open up the sea of ​​suffering!
An ant that he could easily crush to death!
Why? !
He thought deeply about it, and he did not hesitate to contradict his father, and he did not hesitate to reject the woman that the Sirius Saint Girl wanted.
Why was he given to this piece of trash so lightly!
"I don't believe it! I don't believe it!"
Zhao Chenyu suddenly let go of his hand and stepped back as if he had been burned.
He shook his head in despair and kept mumbling.
"I'm going to see my father, and I must ask him clearly in person!"
He didn't even look at Zhao Chenan, and ignored Wu Lanxue who was also pale-faced beside him, and rushed out of the Sixteenth Prince's Mansion like a madman.
Looking at the almost collapsed figure of his third brother, Zhao Chenan sighed in his heart.
Poor third brother.
For the sake of Li Qingluan, he refused to marry the Zhou Dynasty and passed the blame on his "waste brother".
He probably thought that he only had to wait until General Li returned home in triumph before coming to propose marriage.
With the power of his mother-in-law and his own "talent", this marriage is guaranteed.
He never imagined that his father would change his hands like a boomerang.
The goddess he longed for was packed and sent to the bed of his most despised brother.
This outcome is reallyThose who hear it are sad and those who see it cry.
Except myself, of course.
Zhao Chenan even wanted to laugh a little.
At this moment, he felt his sleeve being gently tugged.
He turned around and saw Wu Lanxue's little face as pale as paper.
She stood there, her petite body trembling slightly.
The sweetness that arose just because of Zhao Chenan's words "I like it very much" has now been replaced by a coldness.
Concubine...
The husband is marrying someone else again.
She is also the daughter of a cavalry general.
She is the daughter of Li Qingcang who led the troops to defeat the Sirius tribe and turned her from a high-ranking saint to a marriage victim!
An indescribable feeling of humiliation and coldness instantly clenched her heart.
What is this?
Is it another declaration of defeat by the Zhou Dynasty?
Let the daughter of the victor and the princess of the defeated serve the same husband.
The point is that this so-called winner also needs to become a concubine.
Being crushed by him in terms of identity and status!
She really couldn't figure out what Emperor Zhou was thinking!
Zhao Chenan looked at her clear and darkened eyes, and instantly understood all the uneasiness and grievances in her heart.
His heart softened, and he took a step forward and took her into his arms.
The delicate body in her arms visibly stiffened.
"Are you worried?"
His deep voice sounded in her ears.
Wu Lanxue bit her lower lip and said nothing.
But the little hands grabbing his sleeves harder and harder had revealed all her emotions.
Zhao Chenan sighed softly, held up her little face, and asked her to look at him.
"Listen."
His expression was more serious than ever.
"You are the sixteenth prince's concubine. According to the emperor's decree, the matchmaker is marrying the official wife who was brought into my Zhao Chen'an mansion."
"This identity will never change."
"As for the others..."
Zhao Chen paused and said word by word:
"No matter whose daughter she is, once she enters this door, she is just a side room and a concubine."
"The difference between a wife and a concubine."
"Do you understand?"
His words seemed to carry a soothing power.
Wu Lanxue stared at him blankly, looking at his serious expression and listening to his solemn promise.
First wife...concubine...
Yes, she is the princess.
That Li Qingluan, no matter how prominent his family background was, was just a concubine.
In the hierarchical royal family, this gap is insurmountable.
My husband... is trying to comfort himself and support himself.
The heart that sank into the ice cellar seemed to be illuminated by a ray of warm sunshine and slowly warmed up.
The tip of her nose felt sour, and she couldn't bear it any longer. She buried her face in Zhao Chenan's chest and said softly "Hmm".
Zhao Chenan hugged the soft and delicate body in his arms, but another wave of waves arose in his heart.
"So, my royal wife, would you like to give birth to a little prince for me?"
Wu Lanxue was stunned when she heard Gao Zhaochenan's words, and then immediately expressed her feelings with actions!
A passionate passionate kiss!
